documents.title: Proceeding Of 3Rd Annual General Meeting Held On 31 July 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores for FY26, representing a 12% year-on-year growth led primarily by its water technologies segment. Second-half performance experienced a strong recovery across all business segments, achieving a record single-month sales figure of Rs. 32 crores in March 2026 and highest quarterly revenue of Rs. 101.4 crores in Q4 FY26.

guidance.claim: Management stated that while the revenue outlook remains positive, profitability presents a challenge in the near term.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive. However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

guidance.claim: The company foresees volume growth of around 15% to 20% in construction chemicals for Q1 of the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: The company expects water chemicals volume growth to be roughly around 10%.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated revenue for FY26 stood at Rs. 326.15 crores, up 12% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Consolidated revenue for financial year 2026 at Rs. 326.15 crores. It is higher by 12% of last financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue reached Rs. 101.4 crores, marking the highest level among all quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: So quarter four financial year 26, the revenue is highest Rs. 101.4 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Consolidated revenue for the second half of the year reached Rs. 188 crores, up 35% compared to H1.
demand_outlook.quote: The second half of this year, our consolidated revenue was at Rs. 188 crores. It's up 35% over H1.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported a robust enquiry pipeline in its Water BU segment.
Construction Chemicals demand saw an 18% increase as activity picked up post-monsoon.
Construction chemicals activity picked up post monsoon following a prolonged monsoon period.
demand_outlook.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

capex_expansion.claim: Chembond Chemicals operates three manufacturing locations.
The company uses outsourced manufacturing for powder repair mortars and plans to expand that network further.
capex_expansion.quote: Repair motors, yeah, they are powder products. So distance from manufacturing is a hurdle so outsourced manufacturing is what we are doing currently and we'll continue to expand that network to reach further away, next slide.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs started increasing from late February and March due to volatility in metal prices such as zinc and molybdenum.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March. A lot of volatility in metals before that.

margins_costs.claim: Increased raw material costs led to an immediate impact of approximately 3% on margins.
margins_costs.quote: But in the immediate month, we saw about a 3% impact on our margins due to these haywire costs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 reached Rs. 51 crores, reflecting a 7% improvement over the prior year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the full financial year is at Rs.51 crores, up 7% over prior.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA margin for FY26 was 14% of sales, while profit after tax margin stood at 10% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: And in terms of percentage margin to sales, EBITDA is 14% of sales and profit after tax is 10% of sales.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced improved margins driven by lower raw material costs and newer product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies

margins_costs.claim: Construction Chemicals faced a 15% increase in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Construction Chemicals 15% Increase in RM price and slow growth in Q2

margins_costs.claim: Material costs increased due to war impact along with volatility in metal compounds.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

orders_capacity.claim: The company entered the new financial year with a strong order book for its water chemicals and equipment businesses.
orders_capacity.quote: Water BU, we are entering this, as I mentioned earlier, with a strong order book for chemicals as well as for the equipment.

orders_capacity.claim: Distribution business volume nearly doubled from 594 metric tons in H1 to 1,049 metric tons in H2.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of volume for first half year, we were 594 metric ton and the volume nearly doubled to 1049 metric tons in second half.

orders_capacity.claim: Water Technologies registered a 36% stronger order book.
Equipment and systems deliveries were reported to be on schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment and systems deliveries on schedule

orders_capacity.claim: The Water BU maintains a strong order book.

capital_allocation.claim: Days sales outstanding for the construction chemicals division stood at around 88 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained industry best AR levels while following a tight credit policy.
Post-demerger compliance requirements are on track.
capital_allocation.quote: Post demerger compliances are on track, records being updated

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of Rs 1.25 per equity share of face value Rs 5 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital investment towards the installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at Dudhwada was Rs 90.76 lakhs during FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

risks_headwinds.claim: A prolonged monsoon from May to October impacted project activity and reduced sales by 2 to 2.5 full months in H1 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: It started in May and ended around October that took out 2 & 2.5 full months of sales for a lot of projects most of the construction activity was impacted.

risks_headwinds.claim: Following the war declaration, severe raw material supply disruptions required the company to invoke force majeure and ration surplus inventory across customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: And post-war declaration, it was a very challenging period. We had limited inventories of surplus inventories but had to ration them across customers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Public sector unit customers did not accept force majeure declarations until the government formally declared it.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: War impact caused material cost increases and volatility in metal compounds.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

risks_headwinds.claim: Construction Chemicals performance was impacted by a prolonged monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

management_commitments.claim: Management foresees volume growth of around 15% to 20% in construction chemicals for Q1 of the current year.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

management_commitments.claim: Management foresees water chemicals volume growth to be roughly around 10%.
management_commitments.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

management_commitments.claim: Post-demerger compliance processes are on track with records being updated.
management_commitments.quote: Post demerger compliances are on track, records being updated

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
